errMessage: Enter a message for this timer.
errInterval: Enter a whole interval between 1 minute and 24 hours.
errUrlfetchCap: A timer message can reference at most {max} different fetched values ({urlfetch:…}).
description: Messages the bot repeats on a schedule while you’re live: announcements, socials, reminders.
degraded: Timers are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
botOnHint: Master switch: timers only run while this is on, and only while you’re live.
inspectorIdle: Select a timer to edit it here, or create a new one.
emptySub: Create one and it starts repeating the moment your stream goes live.
fieldMinChatLinesHint: Skip a post unless at least this many chat lines arrived since the last one. 0 turns this off.
fieldMaxFiresHint: Stop posting after this many times in one stream. 0 means unlimited.
fieldEndsAtHint: Stop posting at this date and time. Leave empty to never stop.
deleteBody: This timer stops repeating immediately. This cannot be undone.
discardBody: You have unsaved changes to this timer. Discard them?
